sampling.training: 128 of the existing 400 exposed train row groups, seed1732
sampling.evaluation: 64 valid row groups, seed1733, excluding every recoverable own prior valid sample
sampling.row_sampling: Train steps 99+i%31, stride31; coprime with periods7 and8. Evaluate every need_prediction AND is_scored row.
sampling.independence_limit: Disjoint from known own samples only; cannot rule out unrecorded predecessor exposure or exposure in the wider campaign. No campaign uncertainty claim.

matched_design.features: All 112 in original numeric host order; no seq_ix, targets, scoring mask, target quantum or future statistics as inputs
matched_design.penalty: lambda0.001, RMS-normalized ridge with unpenalized intercept, no hyperparameter tuning
matched_design.training_weights: abs(clip(target,-2,2)), separate for each target; no mask-propensity fitting
matched_design.phase_filter: Independent EMA per absolute row phase; alpha_P=1-(1-alpha)^P maintains decay per row; initialized at first observed row of each phase
matched_design.cycle_filter: Trailing mean of eight rows, padded with row0 during warm-up, followed by usual causal EMA
matched_design.metric: Global pooled Pearson with both predictions/targets clipped to[-2,2] and abs(clipped target) weights
matched_design.causality: Process warm-up and unscored rows; reset each sequence; verify batch transforms against independent online implementation

tests.premise: If cross-phase averaging explains most EMA benefit, same-phase EMA should lose substantially while cycle averaging should retain benefit.
tests.matched_control: L+EMA32+EMA256; same coefficient count and identical fit/evaluation rows
tests.falsifier: Reject cadence-only account if phase8 retains >=80% of the EMA gain over L and its WP deficit versus EMA is <0.005. Reject phase-preserving filtering as a practical replacement if deficit>=0.005.
tests.support_threshold: Suggest cadence-averaging dependence only if phase8 deficit>=0.01 while cycle8 deficit<0.005; signal-response lag remains an alternative explanation.
tests.inference: Fixed finite CPU EMA/ring-buffer states only, no targets/future inputs

tests.premise: If the apparent period8 contains useful phase-specific structure, phase8 should outperform phase7 with matched size and temporal decay.
tests.falsifier: No specific period8 advantage if phase8 minus phase7 WP<=0.002; a larger gain is exploratory evidence only and requires deduplicated reproduction.
tests.inference: Phase index from current step_in_seq and causal input states

reporting: Save all variants and negatives, exact row-group/seq_ix manifests, per-sequence paired moment contributions, raw pooled scores, resource/failure logs. No public score or strong-baseline improvement forecast.
